stories.title: Supreme Court Makes Key Ruling In Trump Admin’s Ballot Fight On Election Eve
stories.summary: The US Supreme Court rejected the Trump administration’s emergency request to set aside more than 20,000 disputed California mail-in ballots on the eve of the midterm elections. Al Jazeera and the BBC say the decision allows counting to continue, while the Washington Times reports that a lower court called the administration’s list of suspected noncitizens flawed and said it included legitimate voters. The Daily Wire notes that lower courts had also refused an earlier Justice Department request to segregate the ballots.
